description:
Post a new message to an existing Twist thread. This tool allows you to contribute to ongoing conversations by adding your response, update, or comment to a thread. Messages are added chronologically and all thread participants are notified based on their notification preferences.

Example response:
Successfully added message to thread:
- Message ID: 345678
- Thread ID: 789012
- Posted: 6/27/2025, 4:15:00 PM

Your message has been posted to the thread.

Use cases:
- Responding to questions or discussions in a thread
- Providing status updates on ongoing issues
- Adding additional context or information
- Sharing decisions or outcomes from discussions
- Following up on action items
- Contributing to asynchronous team conversations

content.description: The message text to post. Supports line breaks for formatting. Keep messages focused and relevant to the thread topic

thread_id.description: The unique identifier of the thread (e.g., "789012"). Use get_threads to find thread IDs

name: add_message_to_thread
